files.notes/kinematics-1.md:
# Speed and distance

Speed is the length of the velocity vector. Distance covered at a constant velocity is speed times time.
files.notes/kinematics-2.md:
# Units

Velocity is in metres per second, time in seconds. Keep every vector in the same units before combining them.
files.notes/kinematics-3.md:
# Acceleration

Average acceleration between two velocity vectors: a = (v1 - v0) / t, taken per component. t must not be 0.
